notes._about: Shared lyrics cases (spec/lyrics/lyrics.md). Every port reads this file. Times in ms. A line is {start, end}; agent ids as in TTML.
notes.activeLines: lyrics.md §2.1-2.2, 2.7. Metrolist LyricsRetiming.kt:362-460 read without its memory: the lines active at the position (lead 660; a duet's second voice max(250, 660 - 150) word-synced, max(250, 660 - 250) line-synced; overlaps under 250 trimmed). leadMs 0: lyrics by real timing. Expect the active indices.
notes.currentLine: lyrics.md §2.4. Metrolist LyricsUtils.kt:111-121 (findCurrentLineIndex): line i is current while the next line's start is at or after position + 100; -1 before the first. Input: line starts and the position.
notes.offset: lyrics.md §3. Metrolist LyricsUtils.kt:94-107: offset = song + global; lyrics position = player position + offset; a seek by lyrics goes to max(0, lyric time - offset).
notes.sides: lyrics.md §5.2. Metrolist LyricsUtils.kt:160-235 (assignLineAlignments). agents: optional {id: 'person' | 'group' | 'other'}; a line's agent may be null. respect: the sides setting. Expect left, right or center per line.
notes.gaps: lyrics.md §6.1. Metrolist LyricsListIndexing.kt:28-53. A line starts at min(its tag, its first timed word) (5f58b4081). Expect [start, end] per gap, in order.
notes.parse: lyrics.md §11.6. Metrolist MlxParser.kt (EnhancedLrcPrefixTest, 0bc6ec068; LyricsEditor BOM, 459059bb2). input: {format: lrc | enhancedLrc, text}. Expect per line its start and, for word lines, [text, start] per word plus 'bg' for a background vocal.
notes.lrcOffset: lyrics.md §3.5, the LRC standard (Morphe LRCParser.java:719; the reverse of Metrolist LrcTiming.kt): the last [offset:N] on a line of its own, taken from every time, none below 0. Same input and expect as parse.

currentLine.name: 100 ms before the second line: still the first
99 ms before the second line: the second

offset.name: a positive offset shows lyrics earlier
a seek by lyrics never goes below 0

sides.name: two singers alternate, a group is centred
the first singer 'other' starts on the right
85% or more on the right: all swapped
types from the agent list win over the id
sides off: centre, a group too

gaps.name: an intro and a gap between lines
a first line at 6999: no intro; exactly 7000 between lines is a gap
the latest end counts, not the last line's
a word before its line's tag: the countdown ends at the first word (Metrolist 5f58b4081)
a first word after its tag changes nothing; a zero-length word doesn't count

activeLines.name: 660 ms before the next line: still this one
within 660 ms of the next line: the next one
lyrics by real timing: no lead
lyrics by real timing: the next line on its start
a duet, word-synced: the second voice 510 ms ahead, both active
a duet, word-synced: 511 ms ahead is too early
a duet, line-synced: 500 ms ahead is too early
an overlap under 250 ms is trimmed, not a duet
before the first line: none until 660 ms ahead
660 ms ahead of the first line: active
after the last line's end: none

parse.name: text before the first word tag starts at the line tag (Metrolist 0bc6ec068)
a line tag after the first word tag: the leading text starts at that word, never later
an inline background vocal keeps its own leading text, marked bg
a BOM before the first tag is ignored (Metrolist 459059bb2)
a BOM before an enhanced LRC line is ignored

lrcOffset.name: a positive offset shows the lyrics earlier (the LRC standard)
a positive offset past a line's time: never below 0
a negative offset shows them later
the last [offset:] counts; word times move with their line
an [offset:] inside a line isn't one
